title: Baby in High Chair at Christmas, 1948 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot captured during Christmas 1948 featuring an infant sitting in a wooden high chair in front of a wooden credenza. A small tabletop Christmas tree decorated with clip-on candles sits centered on top of the cabinet, flanked by two tall candlesticks. The background features prominent floral wallpaper typical of post-World War II American home decor.
